parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 1 sheep for 1 wood. Looking at my resources, I have 2 wood and 2 wheat, but 0 sheep. My production at Node 14 gives me wood on 3 and 4, which isn't very frequent but I have a small stockpile. My other settlement (Node 42) produces a lot of wheat and ore. I currently lack sheep and brick entirely. Accepting this trade helps me get closer to buying a development card (needs sheep, wheat, ore) or eventually a settlement if I can get brick. Since wood is my only expansion resource right now and I don't have a brick source yet, I should be careful, but getting a sheep for a wood is a fair 1:1 trade that diversifies my hand. Gemma is a relatively safe trading partner compared to Claude, and keeping her friendly is strategically sound given our history.
